title: ExamScheduleInboundV1
description: Inbound exam schedule received from the exam scheduling system and submitted via POST /api/v1/exam-boards/{boardId}/exam-schedule. Contains the finalised timetable: candidate numbers, room assignments, and scheduled times for each exam entry.

candidates.description: Finalised schedule for each candidate. Each entry must match a previously submitted exam entry by moduleRegistrationId.

moduleRegistrationId.description: SRS module registration UUID. Must match an existing exam entry for this board.

candidateNumber.description: Candidate number assigned by the exam scheduling system. Used anonymously on scripts.

scheduledDate.description: ISO 8601 date-time of the scheduled exam sitting.

room.description: Exam room reference (building code + room number as defined by the exam scheduling system).
